title: Bike / E-bike Tour : Downtown, Old Montreal, Waterfront by Fitz
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Operates in all weather conditions. In case of rain, we will provide some stylish rain capes.
Casual, comfortable weather appropriate clothes are recommend, flip flops are not.
This tour is for participants 14 years and older.
Tours can be bilingual upon request (French & English).
Avoid coming by car, parking is extremely difficult near our shop
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our guided small-group rides are a fun, safe, and easy way to experience bike-friendly Montreal. This is a must-do for any visitor, an accessible way to take in the city's key landmarks while enjoying its urban nature along the way.

Expect photogenic scenes at every turn and real insight into Montreal's unique vibe, culture, and history. We'll set you up on a quality bike that's a genuine pleasure to ride, then lead you on a loop route along Montreal's impressive bike paths, quiet streets, and hidden laneways.
This is our most popular tour. You'll cruise through Old Montreal, the Old Port and Riverfront, Downtown, and the charming neighbourhoods of Le Plateau and Le Village. Your guide is one of our specially trained Montreal ambassadors, who'll gradually unravel the city's story, which plays a big part in Canada's own. Along the way, you'll pause at scenic break spots to take in the cityscape, natural views, architecture, outdoor art, and everyday neighbourhood life.
